channel.description: Latest articles from MediaToday Co Ltd (maltatoday.com.mt)

item.title: Looking back 2025 | Malta’s new underclass exposed
item.description: There is more than a hint of irony in the fact that Labour’s economic miracle is largely underpinned by the creation of a new underclass—people who are often seen as expendable... sometimes unceremoniously branded by politicians as a necessary evil to sustain economic growth and social progress

item.title: Looking back 2025 | When fertility became an economic flashpoint
item.description: Fertility broke into mainstream economic discourse in 2025 and although it will continue being analysed in the years to come, it is yet to be seen whether there's time to turn back the clock

item.title: A most memorable year for the National Audit Office | Charles Deguara
item.description: As the NAO prepares to commemorate its 30th anniversary within a couple of years, I strongly believe that the time has come for this institution to actively consider measures to strengthen its internal governance structures, thereby demonstrating alignment between its stated principles and its operational practices

item.title: Arnold Cassola new year message: ‘Momentum committed to brighter, fairer future for Malta
item.description: Momentum Chairperson Arnold Cassola and General Secretary Mark Camilleri Gambin say party is ready to tackle systemic challenges facing Malta in new year’s message urging people to have the courage to embrace a new political reality

item.title: Kiritimati Island is first to welcome 2026
item.description: Kiritimati Island, an atoll in the Pacific Ocean part of the island nation of Kiribati, is the first inhabited place on earth to usher in the new year • Malta's national New Year's Eve party starts at 8:45pm in Valletta

item.title: New governor for Central Bank of Malta
item.description: Alexander Demarco is formally appointed governor of the Central Bank of Malta for a period of five years after having been unanimously approved by parliament’s Public Appointments Committee earlier in December

item.title: Police issue 513 fines, 123 charges after December roadside checks
item.description: One individual was caught driving a car without a licence twice in the same day

item.title: WATCH | Alex Borg addresses those who lost faith in politics in New Years message
item.description: In New Year's message, PN leader Alex Borg says he wants to hear those who think that change is impossible

item.title: WATCH | Prime minister delivers New Year’s message from Manoel Island in symbolic gesture
item.description: Prime Minister Robert Abela used his New Year’s address to underline a shift away from development-led policies, pledging to even to prevent Fort Tigne from being developed

item.title: Hello 2026: Malta welcomes New Year with fireworks
item.description: As the clock struck midnight, the Grand Harbour was the stage for a massive fireworks show that welcomed 2026 • Thousands of revellers flocked to Valletta for the national NYE concert in St George's Square
